title_present.recommendation: Provide a descriptive title for the dataset.

description_present.recommendation: Add a detailed description summarizing the dataset's scientific purpose and methods.

persistent_identifier_present.description: Dataset has a persistent identifier (DOI or accession ID)
persistent_identifier_present.recommendation: Register a persistent identifier (e.g., DOI) for the dataset.

public_access.recommendation: Ensure public access is enabled in the repository configuration.

repository_present.description: Dataset is hosted in an established repository
repository_present.recommendation: Deposit the dataset in a recognized domain-specific or general repository.

machine_readable_format.description: Dataset files are in a machine-readable, structured format
machine_readable_format.recommendation: Use open machine-readable file formats (e.g., JSON, CSV, TSV) rather than proprietary binary files.

metadata_complete.description: Metadata conforms to standard metadata schemas
metadata_complete.recommendation: Complete all standard metadata fields specified by the repository schema.

license_present.description: Dataset has a clear usage license (e.g. CC0, CC-BY)
license_present.recommendation: Specify a clear data sharing license (e.g. CC-BY 4.0) to legalise reuse.

raw_data_available.recommendation: Upload the raw, primary datasets to allow complete reproduction of the analysis.

processed_data_available.recommendation: Provide processed, summarized, or normalized tables for quick reuse.

protocol_available.description: Experimental protocol or methodology is documented
protocol_available.recommendation: Include experimental protocol documentation (e.g., protocol.io links or methods section).

version_information.recommendation: Implement semantic versioning (e.g. v1.0.0) to track dataset releases.

contact_information.description: Contact email or principal investigator contact is provided
contact_information.recommendation: Add contact information or point-of-contact email for support inquiries.

publication_linked.description: Dataset is linked to a peer-reviewed publication
publication_linked.recommendation: Link the dataset to its corresponding peer-reviewed publication.

citations_threshold.description: Dataset has been cited by at least one scientific paper
citations_threshold.recommendation: Promote the dataset in relevant scientific forums to encourage citations.

reuse_count_threshold.description: Dataset has been downloaded or reused in another project
reuse_count_threshold.recommendation: Share metadata in search registries to increase downloads and reuse.
